legacy_coarse_actor.source_review: Journal.checkWriteRequest at line 517 compares the request epoch with the JournalNode-local lastWriterEpoch. A failed last-writer-epoch file write leaves that node at epoch 0 while the client sends epoch 1; the resulting IOException is the intended guard response. Two independent smoke replays confirmed the exact 1-versus-0 transition; see README.md.
